title: Google\Cloud\Monitoring\V3\DeleteGroupRequest
name: DeleteGroupRequest
description: The DeleteGroup request. The default behavior is to be able to delete a single group without any descendants.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.name
params.description: Required. The group to delete. The format is: projects/[PROJECT_ID_OR_NUMBER]/groups/[GROUP_ID]

params.name: data.recursive
params.description: If this field is true, then the request means to delete a group with all its descendants. Otherwise, the request means to delete a group only when it has no descendants. The default value is false.
